Effect.LegacyPixelateFrozen.zh: 当前系统使用静态马赛克；下层画面变化时不会自动更新。
Effect.LegacyPixelateFrozen.en: This system uses a frozen pixelated region; changes underneath are not updated automatically.

Effect.LegacyLiveRegion.zh: 实时桌面滤镜需要 Windows 10 2004 或更新版本；当前区域显示占位遮盖，可重新绘制为静态效果。
Effect.LegacyLiveRegion.en: Live desktop filters require Windows 10 2004 or later. Existing regions show a placeholder cover; redraw them to create static effects.
